title: Construction Placement Pay Index (Amundson Group)
description:
The base salaries US construction professionals were actually hired at, from the placement records of Amundson Group, a construction-only recruiting firm headquartered in Houston, Texas. Placements, not survey answers. Medians, not averages. Base only, before truck, per diem and bonus.

Dated monthly releases as CSV files: the 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile base salary at placement by role over twelve months, with the prior twelve months' median and the change; medians by role for states and metro areas over twelve or 24 months; and the roles whose median moved since the previous release. Covers heavy civil, site development, paving, data center, rail, tunnel, wastewater and underground utility construction in the United States. A role, a state or a metro appears only when its window holds enough placements for a steady median. No client is named and no individual figure is shown.

Live index: https://amundsongroup.com/construction-pay-index/
